sections.h2: Refiners are routing more of their output into petrochemicals

chart.title: National petrochemical intensity rose from 7.7% to 13% in this cycle

sections.h2: Naphtha exports to China doubled in FY2025-26 after two flat years

chart.title: Naphtha exports to China doubled in FY2025-26, the year E20 took hold nationwide
chart.sub: Light and full-range naphtha (HS 27101221 + 27101229), US$ million.
chart.source: DGCI&S TradeStat, export to China, all commodities.

sections.means: A rising share of the freed naphtha is being sold as raw feedstock to China's own crackers.
sections.todo: Check whether FY2026-27 exports keep climbing, and whether any of that naphtha is routed to a domestic KSM plant instead.

sections.h2: Pharma import dependence on China stays near total for most molecules

chart.title: Penicillin G, ciprofloxacin and paracetamol are 91% or more China-sourced
chart.sub: Share of India's API imports from China, %. Latest year reported in the post.
chart.source: PIB China-import Annexure (PRID 2237414, 10 Mar 2026), as cited in the post; paracetamol and diclofenac from industry analysis.

sections.means: Most fermentation-route molecules remain almost wholly dependent on China, and diclofenac is the most open synthetic-route target.
sections.todo: Direct any new KSM scheme at diclofenac sodium first, since it has no PLI project and no market-driven improvement yet.
